* Abstract:
* This form allows an operator to enter an order for blood products
* into the Serve*Care system. Customers normally CALL_FORM in from affiliated
* hospitals to place orders.
*
* Menu Reference:
* Error Conditions:
* 0200 -- invalid function key
* 0201 -- all required fields must be entered
* 0202 -- duplicate sort sequence
* 0300 -- invalid blood type
* 0302 -- invalid customer
* 0303 -- invalid contact
* 0304 -- invalid contact
* 0305 -- invalid attribute code
* 0309 -- invalid product code
* 0600 -- unsuccessful commit
* 1200 -- orderer name must be entered
* 1208 -- All numbers must be entered
* 1300 -- invalid consignee ID
* 1301 -- invalid payee ID
* 1302 -- Customer ID already exists */
* 1304 -- invalid tier
* 1704 -- order has not been completed
* 1705 -- invalid order type
* 1706 -- invalid order class
* 1707 -- invalid quantity
* 1708 -- no standing orders set up
* Inputs:
* Outputs:
* Modules Referenced:
* Assumptions and Limitations:
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* This form allows order entry for user at a blook bank taking orders
* over the telephone. It is not intended for querying, updating or
* deleting orders. It contains 2 major blocks and 7 minor blocks. The 2
* major blocks are:
* - orders: this block contains all info related to an order, the
* associated database table is orders. Customer info and order summary
* are maintained in this block.
* - items: this block contains infos related to order line items, the
* associated table is order_items. Line item product code, blood type
* outdate range and unit price are in this block.
* The 7 minor blocks are
* - contact: this block allows quick entry of a new contact to be added
* to database, it is based on contact table.
* - consignee: user can update or add a ship to customer to the order
* and to customer table. For new customer, user has to create a new
* customer id.
* - attrs: info for special order line items such as antigens,
* special processing cost are in this block, base table is
* product_attributes.
* - item_attr: info for custom order such as pooling and splitting source
* are in this block, base table is order_item_attributes
* - inventory_level: contains inventory levels for a product
* - answer: confirm block for backing out of an order
*

declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :local.s_order_no is not null
 then
 validate_field_and_record;
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from order_items
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and order_no = :orders.order_no
 and item_status = :ordered;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1102'); -- order canceled
 check_package_failure;
 :orders.order_status := :canceled;
 else
 :orders.order_status := :ordered;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 GO_ITEM('orders.order_mode');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ORDERS.CUSTOMER_ID', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ORDERS.CUSTOMER_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ORDERS.CUSTOMER_ID', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 clear_form(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('pre-form');
 check_package_failure;
 GO_ITEM('orders.customer_id');
end;

declare

begin

 then
